progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk3 and dwells most on Gk in Chaharmezrab. Daramad (2:56.1) introduces Ab, centred on Eb. The line peaks at Ab4 (419.4 Hz) at 3:09.4. It closes on the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Ab4 → Gk4 → Gk4 → Gk4).
